pages.title: 重新捕获意识（Recapturing Consciousness）
pages.text: 绯红之眼似乎以某种方式被束缚在远古石柱上。$(br2)利用这个仪式，可以逆向解析这套系统，将眼睛囚禁在我们自己的意识容器中。

pages.title: Recapturing Consciousness
pages.text: The Crimson Eyes seem to be bound to the ancient pillars in some way. $(br2)With this ritual it is possible to reverse engineer this system by trapping it inside our own Consciousness Container.
